results.name: modal shortcut: an untouched Condition dialog has OK disabled; Enter (in the empty value box) applies nothing; Escape closes it
Top 2 shows only the two largest; reopening pre-fills Top 2; Below average; Clear shows every row
Custom: contains "e" Or begins with "z" (wildcards) on the name column; And with a second column's Top 5
Date period: This year on the date column (relative to today)
By colour: swatches come from the column; orange shows only the filled rows; Save → openpyxl sees the colour filter + the same hidden rows; reopening the file keeps them and pre-fills the colour
